Each player holds 3 cards and draws aftereach trick. The trump suit is revealed by the last card dealt,which stays visible until taken. The unusual ranking system (Ace> 3 > King > Queen > Jack > 7-2 in point order) makes Briscoladistinct from virtually every other card game in the world. after.textHead: 🏠 Home O'CENTRA GAMES Login Shop Social Games Competition Leaderboard Player Hub DAILY REWARD 25 50 100 0 75 125 250 25 500 150 200 50 SIGN IN TO SPIN CLAIM DAILY REWARD SIGN IN TO SPIN 3 FEATURED 3 RECOMMENDED BRISCOLA BRISCOLA Italia Gioca Briscola is Italy's most beloved card game, a point-trick gameplayed with the distinctive 40-card Italian deck (suits: coins,cups, batons, swords). Each player holds 3 cards and draws aftereach trick. The trump suit is revealed by the last card dealt,which stays visible until taken. The unusual ranking system (Ace> 3 > King > Queen > Jack > 7-2 in point order) makes Briscoladistinct from virtually every other card game in the world.
